method: Live final compiled V2. Separate Stagehand tab, actual normal arrow keys and visible touch/skill buttons. No game-state or position injection. Canvas screenshots inspected directly. Browser canvas readback used only to count distinct frames in the already served walk image.

checks.name: painted-stage
checks.observed: Final illustrated ground/islands/wind stumps, player/creature and forest plate visible together. Player feet visually meet illustrated grass surface on raised platforms and ground; no visible floating or sinking in inspected captures.

checks.name: melee-level-up
checks.observed: Jumped to first platform and defeated first enemy with Attack: LV1 HP75 EXP35/70. Used updraft to second upper platform and defeated second enemy with Attack: LV2 HP85 EXP70/70 and spell unlocked.

checks.name: height-miss-and-travel
checks.observed: From upper platform, cast right toward lower third enemy. Flower visibly traveled across empty air above enemy, then expired. Leaves remained2/3.

checks.name: direction-miss
checks.observed: Moved onto third platform, faced left and cast away from right-side enemy. Leaves remained2/3.

checks.name: projectile-hit
checks.observed: Faced right and cast at third enemy at same height. Actual traveling projectile contact showed impact ring/particles, enemy disappeared, +35EXP and leaves3/3. Player HP60 after enemy retaliation.

checks.name: bloom-contact-gate
checks.observed: At final portal with3 leaves, ArrowUp was denied with message to hit left-side bloom. Faced left and cast. At120ms during casting, HUD still requested bloom hit. After500ms more and actual projectile contact, HUD changed to 고원의 문 열림, bloom visibly flowered and portal glowed.

checks.name: quest-victory
checks.observed: ArrowUp after bloom contact produced 고원에 별이 피었어요 completion with LV2 HP60.

checks.name: restart
checks.observed: Clicked normal restart after victory. HUD reset LV1 HP100 EXP0/70 and leaves0/3, spell locked.

checks.name: mobile-and-portrait
checks.observed: Character portrait, health, quest, stage and seven touch buttons visible. document.scrollWidth did not exceed viewport width. Duplicate skill footer is hidden on mobile.

checks.name: six-frame-walking
checks.observed: Actual ArrowRight movement produced distinct painted stride poses and position changes in two captures. Served walk-cycle.png decoded576x96; pixel readback counted6 distinct96x96 cells.

checks.name: browser-errors
checks.observed: Captured pageerror and console.error lists were empty during initial final-page load and final restart/mobile/walk interval. All required modules and all required art assets reported HTTP200 in browser Resource Timing.

limitations: No source, graph, release or previous revision evidence was changed in this QA packet.
Artwork cohesion and contact are agent visual observations, not human creative approval or a numerical pixel-perfect contact measurement.
The six-cell atlas is verified distinct; only two live stride poses were captured rather than frame-by-frame video of an entire walk cycle.
Audio listening, V2 defeat and V2 drop-through were not repeated. Existing prior evidence and source self-checks cover defeat/drop, separately from this V2 quest playthrough.
Stagehand's letter/Space key bridge limitation remains, so Jump/Attack/Spell used actual visible buttons; arrow keys controlled movement and portal interaction.
